observation: Three consecutive review rounds raised ill-typed-input findings whose own text cited the previous round's fix ('beyond the prior endpoint fix, kind still reaches a set lookup unchecked'; 'after the malformed-cluster fix, not malformed object fields'). Each field-level isinstance patch left the next unchecked field as the next round's finding, so the round count did not converge on correctness.
reason: Promoted against landed code: four shape tables name every field and are checked before any semantic work runs, with the non-termination lesson recorded in the comment, and the paired test drives all twenty-six declared fields with a wrong type while requiring a diagnostic rather than a traceback. The four-head review sequence that minted a finding per round is this record's originating evidence; an omitted field now fails as a missing table row instead of as the next round's finding.
